review_description: Serenity was really good and I learnt more about solar energy than I had from other installers. I also had to upgrade my power board and James organised that for me too which took a lot of the stress out of the process.

James Bell, the installer was easy to talk to and explained everything I asked for. He was a good communicator and kept me informed with what was happening while we coped with inclement weather during the installation. I’m very happy to recommend.

James did the quote, got back to us promptly with his very competitive quote and he installed the system. I liked that he wasn’t a salesman, he was factual and practical. He spend the time to explain everything and his app makes it easy for us to see what’s happening with our solar. He says he is on hand to fix any issues with efficiency should they unexpectedly arise in the months and years ahead. Very satisfied, would definitely reccomend.

James was easy to talk about solar, without confusing the issue extremely reliable and being a local guy I felt comfortable dealing with him knowing that his company was from the area if anything was to go wrong.He was always contactable when I needed any questions answered.

How was the sales/quoting process? Very professionalHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual? excellent on all criteriaCustomer service was good; James was able to help with some questions around my old solar analytics system.I would not hesitate to recommend Serenity Energy to other looking to install a solar or upgrade to a solar battery like I did
